images.caption: Conveyor Settings — the canonical rarity ladder. The Warn/Auto-Buy grid shows 9 base packs = 9 tiers: Ice(Common) · Sand(Uncommon) · Inferno(Rare) · Lightning(Epic) · Hightech(Legendary) · Dark(Mythic) · Eclipse(Secret) · Isekai(Divine) · Slayer(Transcendent).

Scrolling the same panel: the ladder does not stop at Transcendent. Premium tiers continue — Shadow(Monarch) · Emperor(Pirate King) · Demon · Manga · Celestial(Galaxy) · Heavenly(Heaven) · Corrupted(Void) · Striker(Soccer) · … · Chainsaw · Grail · Blaze · Devour. The full ladder is 41 rarity tiers, each its own pack and card pool.

Exclusive Shop — premium Robux packs with an odds table. Royal Pack (⬡99/299/799): $1.2K 48.5% · $25K 32% · $500K 14% · $40M 5% · LIMITED $500M 0.5%. The odds skeleton is ≈ 48.5 / 32 / 14 / 5 / 0.5%; a higher pack shifts the whole value curve up.

Index — a catalog of 2,132 cards, organized by finish tabs (Normal · Golden · Diamond · Venomous · Rainbow · Sakura · Candy · …). A card's identity = Finish × Rarity × Name; unowned entries are hidden as "???".
The same Cybernetic Heroine (Legendary) in Normal finish — $2.0K/Card.
The same card in Golden — $3.0K/Card (×1.5). Venomous is $6.0K (×3.0).
Plaza from above: three stalls SHOP / SELL / UPGRADE plus six activity stations — CARD CRAFT, CARD RANKING (rank), BOSS RAID, TRAITS ROLL, INFINITY TOWER, FREE REWARDS (ads).

The UPGRADE stall — 5 upgrades with dual pricing (Cash or Robux ⬡): Base Expansion (slots) · Luck Boost (+% rarer packs) · Cash Boost (+% on selling) · Time Boost (−% timer) · Speed Boost. The Cash price escalates steeply per level.

The Items stall — 5 materials: Rank Gems (roll rank) · Trait Gems (roll trait) · Raid Shards (universal, from any boss) · White Titan Shards · Moon Demon Shards (boss-specific, feed boss-card crafts).
Potions — timed boosts. Cash I: "[2 Minutes] +10% Cash Boost", Use / Use(5x), stack cap 250. Three lines (Cash/Luck/Mutation) × three tiers (I–III).

Rank Machine (Card Ranking). Roll rank with Rank Gems (⬡1) or Cash. Rank is the card's Cash multiplier. Ladder: F 1x 32% · E 1.1x 26% · D 1.2x 18% · C 1.35x 12% · B 1.6x 7% · A 2x 3.82% · S 3x 1% · SS 6.5x 0.1% · SR 8x 0.05% · UR 10x 0.02% (+ LR).

Traits Machine (Traits Roll) — a mirror of the Rank Machine but with Trait Gems, pity 1500/4000. A trait is a card's second power multiplier: single-stat tiers (Fortune/Vigor/Strength) plus rare combo traits that buff Cash + Damage + HP at once.
Card Craft — a grid of 13 evolution recipes: Flame Pillar $2.4M · Emperor King $70M · Silent Esper $6.5B · Genius Striker $890B · … · Black Reaper $2.0O/Card (top recipe).
Recipe detail: needs Wind Slayer + Serpent Slayer + Fog Slayer (all Transcendent, 1 each) + $1.8M and a Mutations slot → CRAFT.
Boss Raid: enter through the red portal at Plaza center → an arena. The boss (White Titan) opens on a ~30-min cycle, with a Raid Shop right in the arena. E Boss Fight when it is open.
Raid setup: a team of 4 cards + Equip Best, difficulty EASY / MEDIUM / HARD / NIGHTMARE. A card in combat = HP + DMG + Rank (Vision Striker: ❤1.7Qd / ⚔842.1T).

The fight is 4 phases (segmented HP bar), ~5-min timer. Phase 3/4 = "TITAN RAGE": the boss enrages, damage jumps 261 → 1.3M. Recommended DMG/card by difficulty: Easy 1.3B · Medium 24.4Qn · Hard 4.7O (octillion); Nightmare higher still.

Raid Rewards: x22 Raid Shards + x4 White Titan Shards + a "Cursed Cash" card (Lvl 1). Cooldown is 1 fight per hour. Raid Shop: White Titan card for 150 shards (=50% of your best card), Moon Demon for 175 (=60%).

Infinity Tower: a team of 4 cards → BATTLE. Rewards "every two floors" by milestone: Cash 25% Floor 1+ · potions · Rank Gems 10% Floor 100+ · Trait Gems 16% Floor 200+. The server leader sits at floor 963.

Tower gameplay is a 1v1 auto-battle: your DMG vs the enemy's HP (Fog Slayer 1.1B one-shots early floors). Enemy HP scales per floor; Auto Replay + Show/Hide Battle let you climb hands-free while walking your base. A 2x Tower Speed pass speeds the animation.
Tower rewards for one climb (Floor 68) — the main free faucet of gems and potions: $4.13B + a pile of potions (Cash/Luck/Mutation I–III). This is where a player gets the consumables to roll with.

The native Roblox store: tabs Home · Top picks · Passes · Currency · Consumables. Passes: 2x Roll ⬡299 · 2x Tower ⬡199 · V.I.P ⬡199 · 2x Offline ⬡79 · Auto Conveyor ⬡899 · 2x CASH ⬡119. The ⬡ prices match the API 1:1.

Podiums of Robux chase cards on limited stock: Venomous Almighty King $45.6B/Card ⬡449 (669/1000) · Glitch Vision Striker $5.75T/Card ⬡999 · Admin Ember Elf $33.6Sp/Card ⬡4799 (0/125 — sold out). Buy the dream directly.
The cards panel: Storage 2/150, an Equip Best button ("Equipped 3 best cards!") that auto-fills the base slots with your highest-value cards; a 10-slot hotbar (keys 1–0) for quick placement.
The Upgrades panel with its caps: Cash Boost +200% MAX (→ Cash 3.00x), Time Boost −24% MAX; right side is the persistent HUD Luck 14.60x / Cash 3.00x — the sum of upgrades + passes + gems + potions.
PlayTime Rewards — a session ladder of 12 rewards (cash/packs/cards) that resets when you leave ("Leaving Resets Progress!"). Claim All for ⬡449 monetizes impatience.
Free Rewards — a rewarded ad: 4 videos/day, a random drop from Rank Gems / Trait Gems / Time III / Luck III / Cash III potions. An F2P trickle of gems and consumables.
Player gifting: another player sends an "@player Gift You!" popup with Accept/Decline. This is the trade channel; Settings has a "Block Gift request" toggle (default NO).

In place of achievement badges are collective goals: a "LIKE THE GAME FOR BIG UPDATE" board with a like counter 61.3K/100K and "JOIN THE GROUP FOR 1.25x CASH". Social actions convert into an in-game bonus and update pressure.
The full-screen pack open: the card art fills the screen with $/Card + Rarity + Finish (Titan Shadow — Shadow — Diamond).
Each finish gets its own color and glow (Wind Slayer — Transcendent — Diamond). Rarity reads instantly from the frame and shine.
